# SCI-MAP v0.1 Science-Team Rationale r0.3 Change Log

Date: `2026-08-16`

Status: surgical final correction pass; SCI-MAP house rationale frozen

## Changes

- Made the unit-variance and true inverse-variance assumptions explicit in
  the fractional-projection example and stated its covariance and unity
  correlation consequence.
- Clarified atomic observation-bundle admission while preserving pixel-level
  support as the authority for where an admitted observation contributes.
- Defined the selected processed-sample vector before the response equation.
- Narrowed the FITS statement to ordinary WCS pixel-to-sky use and separated
  normalization from formal precision in the science-user table.
- Recorded scientific-owner approval of `SCI-MAP-CI-001`, amended the shared
  equations, REQ-031/032, and PRED-012 to make `coverage_cut` dimensionless,
  and narrowed OD-007 to numerical-domain and failure-policy questions.
- Compressed the contents to the executive summary and numbered main sections
  and added filenames carrying both contract and document revision axes.

No section architecture, estimator, figure structure, ownership table,
eight-fact support table, validation hierarchy, requirement/prediction ID, or
open-decision ID was changed. No implementation inspection, validation,
reduction, or production claim was performed.
